description.value: Hometown Pizza is a neighbourhood pizza and fast-food restaurant on Fraser Street in Vancouver's south end, offering a broad menu spanning pizzas, baked pastas, fish and chips, pakora, wings, and fries. The shop operates primarily as a call-ahead takeout and delivery spot with three phone lines. It sits along a well-travelled south Vancouver cycling corridor and makes a practical hot-meal stop for riders heading toward the river or the airport greenway.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (6665 Fraser Street, Vancouver, BC V5X 3T6) and confirms the business is an active takeout and delivery pizza restaurant. Three phone numbers appear on the website (604-324-2222, 604-322-1212, 604-324-1500) absent from OSM tags. The menu explicitly lists vegetarian sauce options for pastas; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; website lists three numbers (604-324-2222, 604-322-1212, 604-324-1500) — primary used in phone field.
Website copyright footer reads 2021; no later date visible, but content and ordering details appear current and the business does not appear closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pizza and fast-food restaurant with a confirmed address and operating website. Useful stop for cyclists on the Fraser Street corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists 'Vegetarian / Meat Sauce' as an option for lasagna, spaghetti, and ravioli dishes
